answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a mutual-credit network: identities extend small lines of credit to each other, and a default propagates to every counterparty who trusted the defaulter. A hollow of clones cannot bootstrap credit because each line must come from an independent honest party; a pigment of fake reputation does not survive a default. A jade of long, settled relationships keeps its credit lines open. The attacker's cost is that credit is relational and lossy, so a farm must convince real counterparties to risk funds on every clone.
